text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just...There are so few clouds in
the sky
today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, could we continue our meeting
tonight?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without giving me a second to respond,
Silence
Suzuka rushes out the door.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was looking up at the sky while I was
running,
and when the sun started going
down...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The whole sky turned a deep red. Then,
all of a
sudden, I could see the stars and
the moon...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We pick up our meeting where we left
off, though
Silence Suzuka seems to be
in a much better
mood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It got cloudy as soon as I started
running. I
couldn't see the sun at all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was so much prettier when I stepped
out. If only
I had left earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear Silence Suzuka's feeling down,
so I
decide to postpone the remainder of
our meeting
until tomorrow.
